clauses.quote: The School Chapter Advisory Committee and the WTU shall have the right to have vending machines installed in Teacher lounges
clauses.subject_text: The School Chapter Advisory Committee and the WTU

clauses.quote: and shall assume all responsibilities therefore.
clauses.subject_text: The School Chapter Advisory Committee and the WTU

clauses.quote: Both internal and external audit reports on the SAF shall be available, upon request, to the faculty, School Chapter Advisory Committee and the public.
clauses.subject_text: Both internal and external audit reports on the SAF

clauses.quote: The work year for 10-month ET-15 Teachers shall be one hundred ninety-two (192) days, of which not more than one hundred eighty-five (185) shall be Instructional Days.
clauses.subject_text: The work year for 10-month ET-15 Teachers
clauses.notes: Defines maximum work year length, functioning as a protective cap on teacher workload.

clauses.quote: DCPS shall have the right to extend the work year up to one hundred ninety-six (196) days, provided that each additional day beyond the one hundred ninety-two (192) days referred above is used for professional development jointly developed by DCPS and the WTU.
The work year for eleven-month Teachers shall be two hundred ten (210) days.
clauses.subject_text: The work year for eleven-month Teachers

clauses.quote: ET 15/11 Teachers shall receive the same holidays and breaks as ET 15 Teachers, including July 4th, the day after Thanksgiving and winter and spring breaks.
